tools.name: proof_fetch_preflight
tools.description: Free: checks a public URL and returns fetchability, provenance, hashes, deterministic injection indicators and a free preview of the first 1,000 or so characters of text (short pages come back whole); not a safety guarantee. No payment or purchase. Example: {"url":"https://example.com/","maxChars":3

tools.name: proof_fetch_offer
tools.description: Returns the offer and request schema without buying. Full cited text: 1,000 free extractions with a free key (no card), then $0.01 a page either way: a 500-page card pack for $5, or $0.50 per Stripe MPP call, which returns the page plus an API key holding 49 more. Cited text uses POST /v1/evidence w

tools.name: proof_fetch_map
tools.description: Free: lists the addresses of a public site from its robots.txt sitemaps, /sitemap.xml and the links on the page given. No key, nothing extracted or charged. Use it to find the pages to fetch. Example: {"url":"https://example.com/","search":"/docs/"}.

tools.name: proof_fetch_evidence
tools.description: Fetch a public URL and return its cited, paragraph-addressable text with integrity hashes and a receipt. Uses one credit from a ProofFetch key, and only when extraction succeeds. Needs the key sent as the MCP request header Authorization: Bearer <key>: a free key holds 1,000 extractions (no card, PO

tools.name: proof_fetch_crawl
tools.description: Maps a public site and returns cited text for its first pages (1 to 10 per call), one key credit per page that succeeds, with one fingerprint over the whole set. The rest of the map comes back as remainingUrls. Takes the same output options as proof_fetch_evidence. Needs the key as the MCP request h

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: proof_fetch_preflight, proof_fetch_offer, proof_fetch_map, proof_fetch_evidence, proof_fetch_crawl · Private data: proof_fetch_offer · Public sink: proof_fetch_offer, proof_fetch_evidence.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: proof_fetch_preflight, proof_fetch_offer, proof_fetch_map, proof_fetch_evidence, proof_fetch_crawl · Private data: proof_fetch_offer · Public sink: proof_fetch_offer, proof_fetch_evidence

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
